days.note: Header read off the graphic: FRIDAY OCT 10 2014. It is the graphic the 2014 schedule page embedded (Wayback capture 20141020054914 of iiipoints.com/schedule/). Four stage columns, MAINFRAME, MINDMELT, SECTOR3 and SKATESPACE, under a STAGE > TIME axis from 7:00 to 3:00. Every set prints a start only, so every row is open-ended; starts after midnight belong to the night they close. Names are kept as printed, with a smaller-type word under a name kept in parentheses. JACQUES GREENE prints (LIVE) under the name. NURI W/ ROBB BANK$ is recorded as printed.
days.method: every block in the graphic compared with its row: billing, stage column, start and end
